lemmas.name: ts_in_init
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (i : Nat), i < nums.length → i + 1 ≤ (i + 1) ∧ (i + 1) ≤ nums.length ∧ (false = true → i < 0 ∧ 0 < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[0]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < 0 → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (false = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < (i + 1) → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target)
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target i hi
  exact Refine.ts_inner_init (fun a b => nums[a]! + nums[b]!) target nums.length i hi

lemmas.name: ts_in_step
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (i j jb : Nat) (ok : Bool), (i + 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ nums.length ∧ (ok = true → i < jb ∧ jb < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[jb]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < jb → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (ok = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < j → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → (j < nums.length ∧ ok = false) → (i + 1 ≤ (j + 1) ∧ (j + 1) ≤ nums.length ∧ ((decide (nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target) || ok) = true → i < (if nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target then j else jb) ∧ (if nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target then j else jb) < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[(if nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target then j else jb)]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < (if nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target then j else jb) → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ((decide (nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target) || ok) = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < (j + 1) → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target))
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target i j jb ok hinv hg
  exact Refine.ts_inner_step (fun a b => nums[a]! + nums[b]!) target nums.length i j jb ok hinv hg

lemmas.name: ts_in_exit
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (i j jb : Nat) (ok : Bool), (i + 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ nums.length ∧ (ok = true → i < jb ∧ jb < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[jb]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < jb → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (ok = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < j → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → ¬ (j < nums.length ∧ ok = false) → ((jb, ok).2 = true → i < (jb, ok).1 ∧ (jb, ok).1 < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[(jb, ok).1]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < (jb, ok).1 → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ((jb, ok).2 = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target)
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target i j jb ok hinv hn
  exact Refine.ts_inner_exit (fun a b => nums[a]! + nums[b]!) target nums.length i j jb ok hinv hn

lemmas.name: ts_out_init
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int), 0 ≤ nums.length ∧ (false = true → 0 < 0 ∧ 0 < nums.length ∧ nums[0]! + nums[0]! = target ∧ (∀ i' j', i' < 0 → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ∀ j', 0 < j' → j' < 0 → nums[0]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (false = false → ∀ i' j', i' < 0 → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target)
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target
  exact Refine.ts_outer_init (fun a b => nums[a]! + nums[b]!) target nums.length

lemmas.name: ts_out_step
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (i a b : Nat) (found : Bool) (jr : Nat × Bool), (i ≤ nums.length ∧ (found = true → a < b ∧ b < nums.length ∧ nums[a]! + nums[b]! = target ∧ (∀ i' j', i' < a → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ∀ j', a < j' → j' < b → nums[a]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (found = false → ∀ i' j', i' < i → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → (i < nums.length ∧ found = false) → ((jr.2 = true → i < jr.1 ∧ jr.1 < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[jr.1]! = target ∧ ∀ j', i < j' → j' < jr.1 → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (jr.2 = false → ∀ j', i < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i]! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → ((i + 1) ≤ nums.length ∧ ((jr.2 || found) = true → (if jr.2 = true then i else a) < (if jr.2 = true then jr.1 else b) ∧ (if jr.2 = true then jr.1 else b) < nums.length ∧ nums[(if jr.2 = true then i else a)]! + nums[(if jr.2 = true then jr.1 else b)]! = target ∧ (∀ i' j', i' < (if jr.2 = true then i else a) → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ∀ j', (if jr.2 = true then i else a) < j' → j' < (if jr.2 = true then jr.1 else b) → nums[(if jr.2 = true then i else a)]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ((jr.2 || found) = false → ∀ i' j', i' < (i + 1) → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target))
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target i a b found jr hinv hg hjr
  exact Refine.ts_outer_step (fun a b => nums[a]! + nums[b]!) target nums.length i a b found jr hinv hg hjr

lemmas.name: exists78
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int), (let pairwiseSum := List.range nums.length |>.flatMap (fun i => nums.drop (i + 1) |>.map (fun y => nums[i]! + y)); nums.length > 1 ∧ pairwiseSum.count target = 1) → ∃ i j, i < j ∧ j < nums.length ∧ nums[i]! + nums[j]! = target
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target h
  obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := h
  have hmem : target ∈ ((List.range nums.length).flatMap (fun i => (nums.drop (i + 1)).map (fun y => nums[i]! + y))) :=
    List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hy⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hmem
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hy1
  simp only [List.length_drop] at hk
  have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
  refine ⟨i, i + 1 + k, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [List.getElem_drop] at hy2
  rw [getElem!_pos nums (i + 1 + k) (by omega)]
  exact hy2

lemmas.name: exit78
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (target : Int) (h : twoSum_precond nums target) (i a b : Nat) (found : Bool), (i ≤ nums.length ∧ (found = true → a < b ∧ b < nums.length ∧ nums[a]! + nums[b]! = target ∧ (∀ i' j', i' < a → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ ∀ j', a < j' → j' < b → nums[a]! + nums[j']! ≠ target) ∧ (found = false → ∀ i' j', i' < i → i' < j' → j' < nums.length → nums[i']! + nums[j']! ≠ target)) → ¬ (i < nums.length ∧ found = false) → twoSum_postcond nums target (a, b) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums target h i a b found hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hf1, hf2⟩ := hinv
  unfold twoSum_postcond
  by_cases hf : found = true
  · obtain ⟨hab, hb, hs, _, _⟩ := hf1 hf
    exact ⟨hab, by omega, hb, hs⟩
  · exfalso
    have hff : found = false := by simpa using hf
    have hin : i = nums.length := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hn ⟨by omega, hff⟩
    obtain ⟨i', j', hij, hj, hs⟩ := exists78 nums target h
    exact hf2 hff i' j' (by omega) hij hj hs
